request.spec:
A button downloads the people as a CSV file: a header line name,grade,retired-from,due-total,
then one line per person in list order, retired people included, with the grade in force today,
the retired-from date or nothing, and the due-total as shown. A value holding a comma, a quote or a
line break is wrapped in double quotes, with any quote inside doubled. Lines end with a line
feed.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A button downloads the people as a CSV file: a header line name,grade,retired-from,due-total,
then one line per person in list order, retired people included, with the grade in force today,
the retired-from date or nothing, and the due-total as shown. A value holding a comma, a quote or a
line break is wrapped in double quotes, with any quote inside doubled. Lines end with a line

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added an "Export people (CSV)" button (`data-testid="export-people"`) to the People section, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

When pressed, it downloads `people.csv`. The file has the header `name,grade,retired-from,due-total`, then one line per person in list order. Retired people are always included, even when "Show retired" is off. Each line has:
- the grade in force on the sheet's today;
- the retired-from date, or nothing;
- the due-total exactly as the list shows it, including `n/a`.

A value with a comma, a quote or a line break is wrapped in double quotes, with any quote inside doubled. Every line ends with a line feed.

The CSV is built in the browser from what the screen already holds, using the same code the list uses for grade and due-total, so the two can't disagree. Nothing on the server changed, and the export writes no audit record (the test expects none). The change is all in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`.
